consistency.issueDetail.AXIOM_MAGIC_CONF: Your world axioms restrict supernatural/magic content, but the power system or related text reintroduces it.
consistency.issueDetail.AXIOM_VIOLATION: Naming, genre promise, or core concepts are inconsistent with the world's underlying rules; unify the main setting.
consistency.issueDetail.CONFLICT_WEAK: Add the opposing sides, triggering events, escalation path, and cost of failure to make the world's central conflict clearer.
consistency.issueDetail.GENRE_MISMATCH: The naming or keywords convey a different genre expectation that does not match the style and rules emphasized by the world handbook.
consistency.issueDetail.REDUNDANT_AXIOM_: The supplementary content mainly repeats existing rules; remove the redundant restatements and keep only genuinely new constraints.
consistency.issueDetail.TECH_ERA_MISMATC: The technology description mixes elements from different era tiers without explaining their origin, limits, or transition logic.
consistency.issueDetail.THEMATIC_INCOHER: The auxiliary context introduced a thematic expression not clearly established in the original setting, which can cause the world's main axis to drift.
consistency.issueDetail.fallback: The system detected a {{field}}-related issue. Please review this risk against the world handbook.
consistency.issueMessage.AXIOM_MAGIC_CON: The world axioms conflict with the power-system settings.
consistency.issueMessage.AXIOM_VIOLATION: The world name or core concepts conflict with existing axioms and background.
consistency.issueMessage.BASELINE_PASS: No obvious hard conflicts found at the rule level.
consistency.issueMessage.CONFLICT_WEAK: Core conflict information is too thin to provide adequate support.
consistency.issueMessage.GENRE_MISMATCH: Genre signals are inconsistent with the world handbook constraints.
consistency.issueMessage.REDUNDANT_AXIOM: The supplementary content merely restates existing axioms without adding new effective constraints.
consistency.issueMessage.TECH_ERA_MISMAT: Technological eras feel mixed without sufficient explanation.
consistency.issueMessage.THEMATIC_INCOHE: Retrieved supplementary content introduced a thematic framework inconsistent with the core setting.
consistency.summary.done: The world handbook review is complete.
consistency.summary.passed: The world handbook passed review with no obvious hard conflicts.
consistency.summary.warn: Detected {{warnCount}} warnings. Further fixes are recommended.

list.usage.step3: 3. When the book copy and the world sample differ, you manually decide whether to push or pull.
